description:
Build unsigned Solana transactions ready for signing. Returns the unsigned transaction and fee details. After preparing, sign locally and broadcast via broadcast_signed_transaction.

Actions:
• native-coins: Build an unsigned native SOL transfer
• spl-tokens: Build an unsigned SPL token transfer

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• native-coins: 180
• spl-tokens: 240

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

amount.description: Amount in lamports for native-coins, or token base units for spl-tokens (required for all actions)

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

feePriority.description: Fee priority tier - defaults to standard if omitted

tokenContract.description: SPL token mint address (required for spl-tokens)

name: prepare_transactions__prepare_transactions_solana
